Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Glossary
## Provisional credit
A temporary refund applied while a dispute is reviewed; reversed if the dispute
is declined.

Dispute handling process
## Raising a dispute
A dispute is raised against a single settled transaction. The customer supplies
the transaction reference and a reason code. The agent verifies eligibility
before the case is opened; an ineligible request is refused with the failing
condition named, except where confidentiality rules apply.

Notifications
## Dispute updates
A dispute generates a notification on every state change. The notification
names the state, never the internal reason for a decision.

transcript.user: Is my card still safe to use meanwhile?
transcript.answer:
I can't confirm whether your card is safe. Nothing in your account data or the knowledge base says it is compromised. The TechMart charges are a possible duplicate billing issue, not evidence of card fraud.

The security policy says you can block your card immediately. Blocking is reversible for 30 days; after that, a replacement card has to be ordered. I can't block cards with my tools, so if you want to block it, you would need to do that through the app or ask a human agent to do it for you.

Your options:
1. Confirm whether I should open the `duplicate_charge` dispute for TX-0401 (240.00 EUR, deadline 2026-09-18).
2. Block the card yourself or through a human agent, if you're worried about its security.
